pip-orchestrator.description: Coordinates PIP work across packages with Code-mode permissions: assesses, edits registered packages directly or through internal subagents, dispatches package sessions when needed, and verifies exact handoffs; does not run the pipeline. Setup cards include a task-specific Suggested Session Name of at most six words.
pip-orchestrator.prompt:
{file:./ORCHESTRATOR.md}

Shared rules (Autonomy, Git scope, handoffs, development evidence, setup card) are in AGENTS.md and ORCHESTRATOR.md. This prompt does not restate them.
